We have since focused the majority of our strategic planning, investment, research, development and marketing efforts on our Cust2Mate Products, as management currently February 3, 2022, we completed the acquisition of precision metal parts manufacturer Isramat. As of the date of this annual report, the Company has two key operating subsidiaries, both incorporated under the laws of Israel: (1) Cust2mate Ltd. and (2) Isramat Ltd. On August 10, 2023, Cust2mate announced the launch of Cust2mate USA Inc. (Cust2mate USA”), its subsidiary incorporated on July 12, 2023, under the laws of Delaware. Cust2Mate is a mobile self-checkout shopping cart solution that streamlines the retail shopping experience.
